markers.impact: Reduced Adenosine Deaminase activity / elevated sleep pressure
markers.interpretation: ADA breaks down adenosine (the sleep-pressure molecule). The rs73598374 A allele reduces ADA activity. A-carriers accumulate adenosine slower but have higher baseline levels, leading to deeper sleep and more slow-wave activity, but potentially higher morning sleep inertia.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Actual sleep architecture is heavily impacted by circadian alignment, blue light exposure, and sleep hygiene.

sources.name: ADA genetic variant and human sleep EEG
sources.notes: Associates the G22A (rs73598374) variant with deeper slow-wave sleep in healthy individuals.

markers.impact: Circadian rhythm phase shifting / sleep fragmentation
markers.interpretation: PER2 is a core clock gene. The rs934945 A allele has been associated with sleep schedule disruptions, night awakenings, and anxious dreams in small clinical cohorts. A research-grade chronotype marker.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Research variant with low statistical power; does not override entrainment factors (light exposure, timing of food).

sources.name: PER2 clock gene variants and sleep phenotype
sources.notes: Analyzes correlation of PER2 variants with waking/sleeping chronotypes.

markers.impact: Altered circadian clock speed / eveningness preference
markers.interpretation: The CLOCK 3111C allele is robustly associated with eveningness chronotype ('night owl') and elevated sleep latency. Individuals carrying the C allele may experience delayed melatonin secretion onset.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Chronotype is highly plastic and entrains strongly to morning sunlight and meal times.

sources.name: CLOCK gene polymorphism and eveningness chronotype
sources.notes: Seminal study mapping 3111T>C to diurnal preference.

markers.impact: Reduced melatonin receptor density / impaired morning insulin release
markers.interpretation: MTNR1B rs10830963 G allele drives increased expression of melatonin receptors on pancreatic islet cells, causing prolonged inhibition of insulin secretion during the morning when melatonin is high. Explains circadian-metabolic glucose mismatch.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Suggests avoidance of high-carbohydrate meals immediately after waking or close to bedtime.

sources.name: MTNR1B and type 2 diabetes risk
sources.notes: Large GWAS identifying MTNR1B as a circadian regulator of pancreatic beta-cells.
